df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
sub = df[df.account_id=='S5Tfd67'].copy()
d16 = sub[sub.date=='2025-10-16']

key=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']

m = agg16.join(aggp, lsuffix='_16', rsuffix='_prev')
m['cost_diff']=m.cost_16-m.cost_prev
m['price_diff']=m.price_16-m.price_prev
m['n_diff']=m.n_16-m.n_prev
print(m.sort_values('cost_diff', ascending=False).head(15).round(2))

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# robust: median of +-14 days excluding target

    dt = pd.Timestamp(d)
    window = daily[(daily.index>=dt-pd.Timedelta(days=14))&(daily.index<=dt+pd.Timedelta(days=14))]
    others = window.drop(dt)
    print(d, daily[dt], "median others:", others.median(), "z vs window std:", (daily[dt]-others.mean())/others.std())

# robust: median of +-14 days excluding target
for d in ['2025-10-16','2025-10-18']:
    dt = pd.Timestamp(d)
    window = daily[(daily.index>=dt-pd.Timedelta(days=14))&(daily.index<=dt+pd.Timedelta(days=14))]
    others = window.drop(dt)
    print(d, daily[dt], "median others:", others.median(), "z vs window std:", (daily[dt]-others.mean())/others.std())
"}
